name: Movie Night
description: Turn a mood, viewing constraint, or a few favorite movies into a focused movie-night shortlist. Public Trakt metadata and related-title signals are required; optional TMDB artwork, Trakt video metadata, YouTube trailer search, and Brave streaming context enrich a dated Canvas recommendation without requiring Trakt account OAuth. Example: /movie_night thoughtful mind-bending sci-fi like Inception and Arrival, under two hours, preferably on Max or Prime.

movie_request.default: Give me a varied movie-night shortlist from current public Trakt signals.

steps.abort_speech: Movie Night needs the Trakt public movie tool. Configure TRAKT_API_KEY with a Trakt application Client ID in the active mode environment.
steps.description: Build the required source-ranked movie candidate set from public Trakt metadata
Optionally enrich the leading recommendation with a balanced TMDB poster, backdrop, and logo bundle
Optionally verify and display trailer choices for the leading candidate

params.query: Current US streaming availability for ${top_title} ${top_year}, ${second_title}, and ${third_title}; check Max HBO, Paramount Plus, Prime Video, Amazon rental, and YouTube rental. Viewer request: ${movie_request}

steps.description: Optionally check current US streaming or rental evidence for the leading candidates
Create the dated Canvas movie-night brief

success_speech: Your movie-night shortlist is ready in Canvas with a best-fit pick and varied alternatives.
partial_speech: Your movie-night shortlist is ready in Canvas using Trakt and the optional artwork, trailer, or streaming sources that were available.
abort_speech: Movie Night could not be completed. Configure the Trakt Client ID or include a clearer movie mood or favorite title.
